copy.story-5: In 2020, Mr. Joseph Yap started Pak Kopi 1969 with a mobile coffee truck in Sri Petaling, Kuala Lumpur. When the pandemic brought his work as a tour guide to a halt, he turned to brewing coffee to build a new livelihood.
copy.story-6: With the support of his wife and family, that small beginning grew into a brand shared by communities across Malaysia. Behind it is the same determination: work hard, brew with care and treat people sincerely.
copy.story-11: Built one cup at a time.
copy.story-12: A difficult year became a new beginning. Every freshly poured cup was a chance to earn trust, welcome a returning customer and take the next small step.
copy.story-15: Integrity sits at the heart of the business. Sincerity towards customers and franchise partners, care for coffee quality and thoughtful service guide the way forward.
copy.story-18: From the family who stood beside the founder to the customers and partners who believed in him, this journey has always been shared. That support gives every new chapter its meaning.
copy.story-25: Make time for your next cup.
